review:
A 243-ways Egyptian game with falcons, scarabs and pyramids – and a different kind of free spins. The grid clears to show coins only, and a multiplier reel beside it boosts every spin by 1x, 2x, 3x or 5x.

Fill every position in the bonus to win the 1,000x Grand Prize. Medium volatility, 2,500x max and 97.02% RTP, with free spins about once every 120 spins. A classic look with a modern coin bonus.
pros: Excellent 97.02% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 120 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
